yogas.name: Budhaditya Yoga
yogas.formula: Sun and Mercury conjunct in the same house
yogas.description: Sharp intellect, analytical capability, government favor, administrative skills, and professional acclaim.

yogas.name: Dharma-Karma Adhipati Yoga
yogas.formula: 9th Lord (Sun) and 10th Lord (Mercury) conjunct in House 6
yogas.description: Grants high administrative authority, executive leadership, righteous conduct, and career prosperity.

yogas.name: Harsha / Sarala Vipareeta Raja Yoga
yogas.formula: Dusthana lord placed in another Dusthana house
yogas.description: Rise to power, wealth, and prominence through sudden unexpected opportunities or defeat of rivals.
